title: Reproduce: Comprehensive molecular characterization of human colon and rectal cancer
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 22810696 (Comprehensive molecular characterization of human colon and rectal cancer) using TCGA/GDC or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 22810696: Comprehensive molecular characterization of human colon and rectal cancer. Primary endpoint: colon and rectal cancer molecular characterization and clinical associations. Use TCGA/GDC or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: colon and rectal cancer molecular characterization and clinical associations
rediscovery_target: Recover the reported average treatment effect and high-risk subgroup benefit.
new_discovery_target: Flag subgroups where treatment effect is uncertain rather than overclaiming benefit.

data.name: TCGA/GDC
data.description: NCI Genomic Data Commons / TCGA open harmonized molecular and clinical data.

evaluation.calibration_note: ClinicalRepBench Figure 2D calibration: 0-100 score, 50 approximates trained human paper-level reproduction; static metrics, format-only reports, and source-generic prose are capped by rubric critical checks.

resource_budget._note: ClinicalRepBench paper-reproduction task; source materials are redacted in the public scaffold.
